Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: CRED's gold vault screen - a 3D gold vault rotates into place, its dark window lighting to reveal stacked gold bars, while the total owned value counts up in a ticker below.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
CRED gold, white: top pill "current gold price ₹16,903.33/g"; center a metallic gold vault box with a dark glass window; below "YOU OWN GOLD WORTH" and a large tabular-figure total ("₹13,287.71") with "0.7861g" and a green "+₹384.79" delta; bottom pair "Buy gold" (outlined) / "Start SIP" (black).

## Motion spec
Pattern: 3D vault reveal with a value count-up ticker.
- The screen pushes in from the right (300ms shared-element style from the gold card) as the vault rotates from -25deg yaw to 0 (500ms, ease-out) with a metallic highlight sweeping its face.
- The vault's window lights up: dark glass fades to reveal the gold bars inside (400ms) with a warm glow blooming from within (radial light, opacity 0 -> 0.8).
- The total counts up from ₹6,776.10 -> ₹13,287.71 over 900ms (ease-out), tabular figures so no layout shift; the gram count and green delta fade in at the end (250ms).
- At rest the vault idles: slow +/-3deg yaw sway (4s loop) with the window glow breathing (0.8 -> 0.6 -> 0.8).
- The top price pill ticks its value up every ~2s with a 1-frame green flash.

## Calibration
- The vault reads as real brushed metal - specular highlight tracks the rotation.
- All currency uses tabular lining figures; the count-up never reflows.

## Reduced motion
Vault fades in static (300ms); totals appear instantly.

## Don't miss
- The vault's window is the reveal - bars must be visibly stacked, lit from inside.
- The rupee formatting (Indian digit grouping) is exact: ₹13,287.71.
